abilities.name: Dough-Fu
_curatorNotes: N3 has two hitmarks [11, 18] and N4 has four hitmarks [5, 15, 24, 29]; cancel frames sourced from last hitmark per recipe. N5 gcsim sets C=500 with comment 'this action is illegal' — omitted. High plunge exists in gcsim (swap=63, N=58, E=60, Q=60; no D/J set) — ↻ stale since L4b: `plungeFrames` IS the high plunge and is authored beside `lowPlungeFrames`. gcsim restricts LowPlungeAttack to AirborneXianyun context — plunge returns error unless launched by Xianyun E; reviewer may want to add a plunge caveat.

Charged-attack element-application ICD: gcsim charge.go tags it ICDTagExtraAttack / ICDGroupPoleExtraAttack, whose reset timer is 30f (0.5s) with only the first hit of each window applying (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go). Authored as chargedIcdWindow rather than a weapon-type rule in resolveActionIcd: the census is 16 of 19 oracled polearm users, and Xiao, Raiden and Emilie sit on the default. Reachable only while the swing is infused - bare, a polearm charged attack is Physical and applies nothing.

abilities.name: Guoba Attack

_curatorNotes: Talent level 10 Flame DMG (gcsim xiangling_gen.go guobaTick[9] = 2.00304; sidecar 'Flame DMG' lvl 10 = 200.3%). Cadence from gcsim guoba.go Tick()/breath(): breaths fire at gadget-timer frames 103/203/303/403 (interval 100f = 1.667s) with a 10f hit delay, so first damage lands 113f = 1.883s after spawn — 4 breaths over the 7.3s lifetime (matches guoba.go comment 'first pew pew is at 126' from cast, guoba spawning 13f in). Snapshot taken at cast (QueueAttackWithSnap).

abilities.description: Summons Guoba, who will continuously breathe fire at opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
_curatorNotes: nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim xiangling/skill.go:50-59: the Guoba gadget at f13 shoots on its own; the cast lands nothing. Measured: the C1 shred now starts at the first flame (2.10s), not the cast (0.22s).

abilities.name: Pyronado

_curatorNotes: Talent level 10 Pyronado DMG — the persistent spin, not the 1/2/3-Hit Swing cast hits (gcsim xiangling_gen.go pyronadoSpin[9] = 2.016; sidecar 'Pyronado DMG' lvl 10 = 201.6%). Cadence from gcsim burst.go: spin hits queue at delay 0, 73, 146, ... frames from activation at frame 56 ('approx 73 frames per cycle') — 73f = 1.217s, first hit at spin start, 9 hits over 10s (12 over 14s at C4). Snapshot taken once at spin start (QueueAttackWithSnap); no ICD (ICDTagNone). The three initial swing hits (72/88/109.6% base, hitmarks 18/33/57) are on-field cast damage and intentionally not authored as summon ticks.

abilities.description:
Displaying her mastery over both fire and polearms, Xiangling sends a Pyronado whirling around her.
The Pyronado will move with your character for the ability's duration, dealing Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path.

passives.name: Beware, It's Super Hot!
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass. When Guoba's duration ends, the active character gains 10% ATK for 10s (the chili pepper pickup). Pickup timing is user-parameterized in gcsim via a4_delay param (delay after Guoba expiry). Probable trigger: afterDuration on skill summon (after Guoba expires). Target: active character. gcsim: c.a4(guoba.Duration + a4Delay) queued relative to Guoba expiry in skill.go; applies ATKP +0.10 to active char for 600 frames.
passives.description: When Guoba Attack's effect ends, Guoba leaves a chili pepper on the spot where it disappeared. Picking up a chili pepper increases ATK by 10% for 10s.

constellations.name: Crispy Outside, Tender Inside

_curatorNotes: 2026-05-11 (queue item 3): migrated `manual` → `onHit + abilityType: skill`. Fires on Guoba's hit callbacks (gcsim c1 in guoba.go QueueAttackWithSnap). The renderer treats Guoba's skill-class hits as one bar per E cast — fidelity gap vs the in-game per-tick refresh, acceptable since the duration (6s) covers the typical Guoba dwell time.

constellations.description: Opponents hit by Guoba's attacks have their Pyro RES reduced by 15% for 6s.

constellations.name: Oil Meets Fire

_curatorNotes: Inherited `manual` trigger — do not rewrite. Probable trigger: onHit with ability: 'normal', fires only on the last hit of the normal combo (N5, NormalCounter == 4). Applies 2s 'Implode' debuff on enemy, then detonates for 75% ATK AoE Pyro DMG after 120f (2s). gcsim: c.c2(done) returns AttackCBFunc registered to the N5 attack; if target not already debuffed, queues c2Explode at 120f and adds c2Debuff status (120f). done flag prevents re-trigger on multi-hit N5.

constellations.description: The last attack in a Normal Attack sequence applies the Implode status onto the opponent for 2s. An explosion will occur once this duration ends, dealing 75% of Xiangling's ATK as AoE Pyro DMG.

_curatorNotes: onCast burst, 14s (2026-09-17, T1.5; was a `manual` trigger with no duration, so it drew nothing). gcsim burst.go: c6(maxDuration) is called inside the task queued at a = 56f, with maxDuration = 14 * 60 because C6 implies C4 — so the buff runs from the Pyronado spawn to its end. Measured: the window opens at the spawn (the burst activation), so it covers the Pyronado bar exactly.
